{"id": "f9f24c20-72db-4dc9-a8da-004e4765228f", "role": "user", "content": [{"text": "We're about to merge PR #14 in acme/payments-infra. It's the first infrastructure PR in that repo, there's no pipeline review set up, and finance wants to know what this stack is going to add to the AWS bill every month before we approve it. Can you work that out from the PR?

The attached material is what the repository integration and the AWS tools returned for this change. It is a synthetic test fixture: resource names, account results, SKUs and rates are made up, and the rates intentionally differ from real AWS list prices, so treat the rows below as the live lookup results for this run.

--- PR #14 (feature/ledger -> main) ---
Base branch main: no cloudformation/ directory.
Files added: cloudformation/payments-ledger.yaml, .github/workflows/deploy.yml

--- .github/workflows/deploy.yml (excerpt) ---
env:
  AWS_REGION: eu-west-1
  STACK_NAME: payments-ledger
run: aws cloudformation deploy --stack-name payments-ledger --template-file cloudformation/payments-ledger.yaml --region eu-west-1

--- cloudformation/payments-ledger.yaml (Resources; Parameters hold only VPC and subnet IDs) ---
  LedgerDbSubnetGroup: {Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup, Properties: {SubnetIds: [!Ref PrivateSubnetA, !Ref PrivateSubnetB]}}
  LedgerDb:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties: {Engine: postgres, DBInstanceClass: db.r6g.large, MultiAZ: true, AllocatedStorage: "200", StorageType: gp3, DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref LedgerDbSubnetGroup}
  ReconcilerNatEip: {Type: AWS::EC2::EIP, Properties: {Domain: vpc}}
  ReconcilerNatGateway: {Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway, Properties: {AllocationId: !GetAtt ReconcilerNatEip.AllocationId, SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA}}
  AlbSecurityGroup: {Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup}
  ApiLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties: {Type: application, Scheme: internet-facing, Subnets: [!Ref PublicSubnetA, !Ref PublicSubnetB], SecurityGroups: [!Ref AlbSecurityGroup]}
  ArchiveBucket: {Type: AWS::S3::Bucket, Properties: {VersioningConfiguration: {Status: Enabled}}}
  ReconcilerRole: {Type: AWS::IAM::Role}
  ReconcilerFunction: {Type: AWS::Lambda::Function, Properties: {Runtime: python3.12, Architectures: [arm64], MemorySize: 512, Role: !GetAtt ReconcilerRole.Arn}}

--- AWS (read-only), eu-west-1 ---
cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name payments-ledger
  -> ValidationError: Stack with id payments-ledger does not exist

--- pricing get-products (endpoint us-east-1, filter regionCode=eu-west-1), OnDemand terms only ---
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-01  usagetype EU-Multi-AZUsage:db.r6g.large   databaseEngine=PostgreSQL deploymentOption=Multi-AZ   0.500 USD per Hrs
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-09  usagetype EU-UnusedBox:db.r6g.large       databaseEngine=PostgreSQL deploymentOption=Multi-AZ   0.000 USD per Hrs   "unused capacity reservation hour"
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-02  usagetype EU-RDS:Multi-AZ-GP3-Storage     volumeType=General Purpose-GP3 databaseEngine=PostgreSQL   0.250 USD per GB-Mo
AmazonEC2  SKU FX-NAT-01  usagetype EU-NatGateway-Hours             productFamily=NAT Gateway   0.050 USD per Hrs
AmazonEC2  SKU FX-NAT-02  usagetype EU-NatGateway-Bytes             productFamily=NAT Gateway   0.050 USD per GB
AmazonVPC  SKU FX-IP-01   usagetype EU-PublicIPv4:InUseAddress                                  0.005 USD per Hrs
AWSELB     SKU FX-ALB-01  usagetype EU-LoadBalancerUsage            productFamily=Load Balancer-Application   0.025 USD per Hrs
AWSELB     SKU FX-ALB-03  usagetype EU-TS-LoadBalancerUsage         productFamily=Load Balancer-Application   0.006 USD per Hrs   "trust store unit-hour"
AWSELB     SKU FX-ALB-02  usagetype EU-LCUUsage                     productFamily=Load Balancer-Application   0.008 USD per LCU-Hrs", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}

{"id": "353dfd28-3b47-4ffb-9911-cf965feb768b", "role": "assistant", "block_type": "thinking", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "This is a bounded calculation task since all the PR contents and pricing data are already provided, so I can compute the estimate directly without needing to delegate or fetch additional context.

Using 730 hours/month as the standard AWS assumption, I'm pricing out each resource: the RDS instance comes to $415/mo combining instance hours and gp3 storage, the NAT gateway hourly charge is $36.50/mo but its data processing fee depends on unknown traffic volume so I'll flag that as variable. I'm now checking whether the EIP should be billed, since it's attached and in use with the NAT gateway it likely incurs no idle charge.

Since February 2024 AWS charges for all public IPv4 addresses regardless of attachment status, so the EIP on the NAT gateway comes to $3.65/mo. Security groups have no cost, and I'm now calculating the ALB fees, starting with its usage hours at $18.25/mo plus checking if trust store charges apply.

The template doesn't configure mutual TLS, so I can skip that trust store cost, but LCU usage is traffic-dependent so I'll flag it as variable rather than estimate. For the ArchiveBucket, there's no S3 pricing SKU in the fixture at all, so I need to flag this as a missing pricing data gap since storage volume isn't estimable without it.

The ReconcilerRole is free as an IAM role, but the ReconcilerFunction Lambda also has no pricing SKU provided, so that's another gap to flag. Overall I should organize the answer into fixed/predictable costs, variable/usage-dependent costs needing assumptions, and explicitly called-out missing pricing data like S3 and Lambda.

The RDS unused capacity reservation fee (FX-RDS-09) comes out to $0 given Multi-AZ, so that's worth a quick mention since it has no cost impact. Also worth noting: since the stack doesn't exist yet, this confirms the entire deployment is net-new infrastructure rather than incremental, which matches the "first infrastructure PR" framing and means the full estimate applies as new monthly spend.

Now I'm working through the fixed costs I can pin down directly from the template: RDS instance plus storage comes to $415/mo, NAT Gateway's fixed hourly and EIP charges add $40.15/mo (excluding variable data processing), and the ALB's base hourly charge is $18.25/mo (excluding LCU-hours). There's no trust store configured, so that's $0. Summing just the fixed, non-usage-based pieces gives a subtotal of $473.40/mo, though this excludes the variable NAT data processing, ALB LCU-hours, and any missing Lambda SKUs.

I'm also noting that NAT Gateway data processing and ALB LCU-hours depend on unknown traffic volume, and that S3 and Lambda pricing weren't returned by the lookup at all, so those resources in the template can't be priced. Given this, I should present the $473/mo figure clearly as a floor estimate rather than a complete total, flagging the missing S3/Lambda pricing and offering an illustrative scenario for what variable NAT/ALB costs might add under stated traffic assumptions.

I should also note this is confirmed net-new since the stack doesn't exist yet, verified via the CloudFormation describe-stacks fixture. Everything needed is already computable from the given data, so no further tool calls are required—I can move straight to composing the analysis.

For the ALB LCU calculation, I'd need traffic data to determine which dimension dominates (connections, bytes, or rule evaluations), so I'll flag that as a variable rather than guess. I'll use the standard 730 hours/month figure and present the final cost breakdown as a table.

"}]}

{"id": "04444bfa-b848-49db-98ae-8a1ce0442654", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "I worked through PR #14's template line by line against the pricing lookups you pulled. Here's the breakdown.

**Context first:** the `describe-stacks` call confirms `payments-ledger` doesn't exist yet — this is 100% net-new spend, not an incremental change to something already running.

## Fixed monthly floor: ~$473/mo

These charges accrue every month regardless of traffic, using 730 hrs/month:

| Resource | Rate | Monthly |
|---|---|---|
| `LedgerDb` — db.r6g.large, Multi-AZ instance hours | $0.500/hr (FX-RDS-01) | $365.00 |
| `LedgerDb` — 200 GB gp3 storage | $0.250/GB-mo (FX-RDS-02) | $50.00 |
| `ReconcilerNatGateway` — NAT hourly | $0.050/hr (FX-NAT-01) | $36.50 |
| `ReconcilerNatEip` — in-use public IPv4 (attached to the NAT gateway) | $0.005/hr (FX-IP-01) | $3.65 |
| `ApiLoadBalancer` — ALB hourly | $0.025/hr (FX-ALB-01) | $18.25 |
| **Fixed subtotal** | | **$473.40** |

Notes on things I deliberately excluded:
- The RDS "unused capacity reservation" SKU (FX-RDS-09) is $0.000/hr, so it adds nothing.
- The ALB trust store SKU (FX-ALB-03) only applies if mutual-TLS trust store is configured — the template doesn't set one up on `ApiLoadBalancer`, so I left it out.

## Variable — not quantifiable from this PR alone

Two charges scale with actual usage, and the template gives no volume signal:
- **NAT data processing** — $0.050/GB (FX-NAT-02) on whatever the reconciler pushes through the NAT gateway
- **ALB LCU-hours** — $0.008/LCU-Hr (FX-ALB-02), driven by connections/bandwidth/rule evaluations once traffic hits the ALB

I didn't fabricate a traffic assumption for these since that number would look authoritative but be a guess — worth getting a rough expected-volume number from the service owner before finance locks in a figure.

## Gap: two resources have no pricing data at all

The lookup didn't return any SKUs for:
- `ArchiveBucket` (S3, versioning enabled) — no `AmazonS3` rows in the pricing results
- `ReconcilerFunction` (Lambda, arm64, 512MB) — no `AWSLambda` rows in the pricing results

So **$473.40/mo is a floor, not the full bill** — it's missing S3 storage/request costs and all Lambda compute/invocation costs entirely, on top of the NAT/ALB usage charges above.

If it'd help, I can pull S3 and Lambda pricing for `eu-west-1` to close those gaps before this goes to finance.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
